actor_awards.notes: One of the highest-profile European actresses of the 1950s and early 1960s, often promoted as an international sex symbol. She won the Golden Globe Henrietta Award for World Film Favorite. Later in life, she became a successful photojournalist and sculptor.

filmography.title: Bread, Love and Dreams (Pane, amore e fantasia)
filmography.role_description: A beautiful, spirited, and impoverished village girl nicknamed 'La Bersagliera' who catches the eye of the new police marshal.
filmography.plot: A middle-aged police marshal arrives in a small mountain village and finds himself attracted to a feisty young woman who is secretly in love with his shy subordinate.
filmography.awards: BAFTA: Nomination – Best Foreign Actress; Nastro d'Argento: Win – Best Actress

filmography.title: Beat the Devil
filmography.role_description: The enigmatic, Italian wife of an American adventurer, involved in a uranium swindle in Africa.
filmography.plot: A group of international rogues are stranded in Italy while waiting for a ship to Africa, plotting to acquire land rich in uranium.

filmography.title: Come September
filmography.role_description: The fiery Italian mistress of an American millionaire who decides to get married when he repeatedly delays their annual rendezvous.
filmography.plot: A millionaire who visits his Italian villa every September arrives early to find his majordomo running it as a hotel, and his mistress preparing to marry another man.
filmography.awards: Golden Globe: Win – Henrietta Award (World Film Favorite - Female)

filmography.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
filmography.role_description: The beautiful and compassionate Romani dancer who is loved by Quasimodo and lusted after by Frollo.
filmography.plot: In 15th-century Paris, a deformed bell-ringer falls in love with a beautiful gypsy girl and tries to save her from the corrupt officials of Paris.

filmography.title: Trapeze
filmography.role_description: An ambitious acrobat who manipulates the relationship between two male trapeze artists to secure a place in their act.
filmography.plot: A crippled circus acrobat mentors a young prodigy, but their partnership is threatened when a beautiful tumbler joins their act, causing a dangerous love triangle.

filmography.title: Solomon and Sheba
filmography.role_description: The seductive queen sent by the Pharaoh to destroy King Solomon by seducing him away from his faith.
filmography.plot: Following the death of King David, his son Solomon must defend his throne against his older brother and the wiles of the Queen of Sheba.

filmography.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
filmography.role_description: An Italian woman who has been receiving child support from three different American GIs, all of whom believe they are the father of her daughter.
filmography.plot: During a reunion of his squadron in Italy, a man tries to find out if he is the father of a local woman's daughter, only to discover two other men share the same suspicion.
filmography.awards: Golden Globe: Nomination – Best Actress in a Motion Picture - Musical or Comedy; David di Donatello: Win – Best Actress

filmography.title: Beautiful but Dangerous (La donna più bella del mondo)
filmography.role_description: A biographical portrayal of the famous Italian operatic soprano and actress.
filmography.plot: A heavily fictionalized biopic of Lina Cavalieri, tracing her rise from a music hall singer to an internationally renowned opera star.
filmography.awards: David di Donatello: Win – Best Actress

filmography.title: Fanfan la Tulipe
filmography.role_description: A fake fortune teller and the recruiter's daughter who convinces a young man to join the army, promising he will marry the king's daughter.
filmography.plot: A charming peasant joins the French army after being told a fake prophecy that he will marry the king's daughter, leading to swashbuckling adventures.
filmography.awards: Cannes Film Festival: Win – Best Director (Christian-Jaque)

filmography.title: Never So Few
filmography.role_description: The mistress of a merchant who becomes romantically involved with an American commander (Frank Sinatra) in Burma.
filmography.plot: A hard-bitten American captain takes command of a band of Kachin guerrillas in Burma during World War II and falls for the mistress of a war profiteer.

filmography.title: Strange Bedfellows
filmography.role_description: A fiery, artistic Italian woman who is separated from her American executive husband.
filmography.plot: An American executive in London tries to reconcile with his fiery Italian wife to secure a promotion that requires him to project a stable family image.

filmography.title: Woman of Rome (La romana)
filmography.role_description: A beautiful working-class girl whose dreams of a respectable life are shattered, leading her into prostitution.
filmography.plot: A young Roman woman is manipulated by her mother and a series of men into a life of prostitution, maintaining a complex relationship with an anti-fascist student.

filmography.title: Hotel Paradiso
filmography.role_description: The neglected wife of an architect who agrees to a secret rendezvous with her husband's business partner at a disreputable hotel.
filmography.plot: A bourgeois Parisian tries to have an affair with his partner's wife at a seedy hotel, but a series of farcical coincidences threatens to expose them.

filmography.title: Woman of Straw
filmography.role_description: A nurse hired to care for an arrogant tycoon, who becomes involved in a plot by his nephew to secure his inheritance.
filmography.plot: A ruthless tycoon's nephew manipulates a nurse into marrying his uncle in order to secure his fortune, leading to murder and deception.

filmography.title: Go Naked in the World
filmography.role_description: A high-priced call girl who falls in love with the naive son of a wealthy Greek-American businessman.
filmography.plot: A young man returns from the army and falls in love with a beautiful woman, unaware that she is a prostitute whose clients include his father's business associates.

filmography.title: Imperial Venus (Venere imperiale)
filmography.role_description: The beautiful and scandalous sister of Napoleon Bonaparte.
filmography.plot: A lavish historical drama focusing on the romantic escapades and political machinations of Napoleon's favorite sister, Pauline.
filmography.awards: David di Donatello: Win – Best Actress; Nastro d'Argento: Win – Best Actress

filmography.title: The Law (La loi)
filmography.role_description: A fiercely independent village woman who becomes the object of desire for several powerful men in a corrupt Italian town.
filmography.plot: In a southern Italian village, a cruel tavern game called 'The Law' dictates social dynamics, while a beautiful woman tries to manipulate the men who desire her.

filmography.title: The Unholy Wife (Les espions)
filmography.role_description: A small, early role in a French espionage thriller.
filmography.plot: A psychiatrist managing a failing clinic agrees to hide a spy, drawing international agents into a confusing web of intrigue.

filmography.title: Bad Man's River
filmography.role_description: A beautiful and treacherous woman who repeatedly double-crosses a gang of bank robbers.
filmography.plot: A gang of aging outlaws is offered a pardon and a fortune if they destroy a Mexican revolutionary's arsenal, but they are constantly betrayed by a woman they trust.

filmography.title: King, Queen, Knave
filmography.role_description: The wife of a wealthy businessman who initiates an affair with her husband's naive nephew.
filmography.plot: A young man visits his wealthy uncle in Munich and is seduced by his aunt, leading to a deadly plot.

filmography.title: Falcon Crest
filmography.role_description: The secret half-sister of Angela Channing who arrives to claim a share of the Falcon Crest winery. (TV Series)
filmography.plot: The ongoing saga of the feuding Gioberti and Channing families, wealthy winemakers in California's Tuscany Valley.
filmography.awards: Golden Globe: Nomination – Best Supporting Actress in a Series, Miniseries or TV Movie

filmography.title: Fast and Loose
filmography.role_description: A role in an Italian comedy early in her career.
filmography.plot: A comedy about marital misunderstandings and jealousy.

filmography.title: Aline
filmography.role_description: A leading role in an Italian drama.
filmography.plot: A young woman's struggles in post-war Italy.
